Interested students must be officially 
nominated by their International Office to 
join our Exchange Program. Nominations 
should be submitted through email at 
meamagdangal@mapua.edu.ph or 
cpgonzales@mapua.edu.ph. 
 
Once the student nominations have been 
received by Mapúa University, nominated 
students are required to accomplish the FM-
IL-06-03 Application Form along with the 
List of Requirements for International 
Programs - Inbound and submit the 
required documents accordingly. 
 
Spring Intake (3rd & 4th Quarters – August - 
October)  
Deadline for applications: November 30, 
2027 
 
Fall Intake (1st & 2nd Quarters: February - 
April)  
Deadline for applications: May 31, 2027

Official Business 
STUDENT LIFE 
 
 
Airport Pick-up 
Airport transfers are provided only 
when Mapúa University transportation 
is available. Currently available, but 
guaranteed for one week only. After 
this period, students must arrange 
their own airport transfer.
Accommodation 
Mapúa University offers off-campus 
accommodation only. A list of 
accredited dormitories within the city 
is available upon request.  
The Office of International Affairs will 
provide this list to the student’s  
home university through email. 
 
Official Business 
STUDENT LIFE 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Student Organizations 
and Activities 
 
Mapúa University welcomes international 
students through its International Students 
Organization, which hosts activities such as the 
Research and Learning & Immersion Program 
(RLIP), ASEAN Month, International Month, and 
the International Conference for Sustainable 
Environmental Technologies (ICSET). These 
events provide opportunities for international 
students to meet, bond, and experience both 
Mapúan and Philippine cultures together.  
In addition, Mapúa’s student buddies—Filipino 
students who volunteer to assist—are available to 
support international students during their stay in 
the country. 
International students are also encouraged to join 
Mapúa University’s various student organizations 
and take part in institutional celebrations, including 
Foundation Week, University Week, and Student 
Organizations Week, ensuring a vibrant and 
inclusive campus experience.
